answer: Cosignatures are collected in island, verified in haven, and echo names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 10 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 229 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
